recent_reviews.text: I have never experienced such an unprofessional and shocking service from any GP practice in my life. Little Town Medical Practice is an absolute joke. We booked an appointment and had to wait three weeks just to be seen – that alone is ridiculous. When I finally arrived for my appointment, I signed in and waited 40–50 minutes past the scheduled time. I became impatient because the appointment time had clearly passed. I asked the receptionist, who told me to “wait another 5–10 minutes and the doctor will see you soon.” After waiting another 10 minutes, she then told me I needed to come back four hours later at 3:30pm. What a joke. I had children to pick up from school, so attending four hours later was impossible. I asked if I could be booked in for the following week instead, and I was told they had no availability at all for the next two weeks. Completely unacceptable and honestly disgusting. To make matters worse, while I was there another patient was arguing with staff because the doctor refused to see her child despite them having an appointment as well. That alone shows this GP treats multiple patients the same way. This is not the first bad experience either. On previous occasions the staff have been extremely rude. When complaining over the phone in the past, I was told things like: “Why don’t you change GP?” “Why don’t you move out of Oldham?” Disgusting attitude. Completely unprofessional. Shows clearly that this GP surgery does not care at all about its patients. Little Town Medical Practice needs serious improvement. People rely on their GP for their health and wellbeing, and this kind of treatment is shameful. I would not recommend this surgery to anyone.
